gallery_title: One timer instruction, three listening conditions
visitor_only_transcript: Start the timer for nine minutes.
shared_note: All three listening files use the same attenuation to avoid clipping; this does not equalize loudness.

conditions.title: Original speech
conditions.description: The spoken instruction without added stress.
conditions.observation: The model proposed a 540-second timer. No timer was executed.

conditions.title: Machinery noise
conditions.description: A machinery burst overlaps the duration phrase. Noise is calibrated to −10 dB SNR over the marked number.
conditions.observation: The model proposed a 540-second timer. No timer was executed.

conditions.title: Number segment silenced
conditions.description: The automatically aligned segment for “nine” is replaced by silence.
conditions.response: How many minutes would you like to set the timer for?<|im_end|>
conditions.observation: The model asked for the number of minutes and made no timer proposal.
